hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Soft muted palette (teal, rose, beige, orange) and clean typographic hierarchy show real design intent, but the edge bundles collapse into an illegible dark tangle at the center, undermining the visualization's core purpose.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: scaleSqrt correctly used for force-layout radius encoding and data joins have key functions, but the sunburst applies a second scaleSqrt to the radial depth axis, compounding distortion so arc areas no longer proportionally represent node counts.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Tension slider fires un-throttled redrawLinks() (300 DOM mutations per mousemove) and easing param sliders trigger full updateLayout() on every input with no debouncing or RAF; force layout's 750ms shape-morph transition is never interrupted before the force tick loop begins overwriting transforms; drag and click handlers have no touch/mouse disambiguation filter.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Circle pack clusters read clearly with ~5 distinct colors and good group separation, but 300 edges at 8% bundle tension converge into an opaque central tangle that makes individual connections untraceable; single-view-at-a-time layout and organized controls prevent broader overload.
